title: CreativityPrism task registry entry
description: Contract consumed by runner/run.py and runner/artifacts.py. Exists mainly so editors stop guessing; schemastore maps **/tasks/*.yaml to the Ansible tasks schema, which these files are not.

name.description: Registry key. Must match the file name and the --task argument.

domain.description: Grouping label for reporting only; not consumed by the runner.

folder.description: Repo-relative path to the task bundle.

adapter.description: Repo-relative path to the adapter script.

environment.description: Short env name; the runner pre-flights creativityprism-<environment>. Defaults to modern.

limit_supported.description: Whether the task can honour --limit. Absent means false, and the runner rejects --limit.

slurm.description: Per-task SBATCH directive overrides for --slurm. Keys are directive names without the leading dashes; underscores are accepted for dashes (cpus_per_task -> cpus-per-task). A null or empty value drops the directive. These override runner/slurm_template.sbatch and are themselves overridden by --slurm-override. Values are cluster-specific, so partition and account names must be set for the cluster in use.
